title: Azure DevOps Organization Policy & Dials Schema
description: Validates organization-level configuration dials (Tier 2) against the Azure DevOps Organization baseline (Tier 1).

service_url.description: Full HTTPS URL of the Azure DevOps organization.

default_process_template.description: Default work item process template for new projects unless overridden.

security_dials.description: Organization-level security dials. Note: Public projects (false), Anonymous access (disallowed), and Conditional Access (enforced) are Tier 1 locked baselines and cannot be toggled here.

allow_team_admins_invite.description: Dial: Whether Project and Team Administrators can invite new users to the organization (Default: false).

ssh_authentication_enabled.description: Dial: Whether SSH key authentication is allowed for Git operations across the organization (Default: true).

disallow_third_party_oauth.description: Dial: Block third-party application access via OAuth (Default: true; Entra ID auth remains enabled).

pipeline_dials.description: Organization and default project pipeline dials. Note: Classic Build and Classic Release pipelines are disabled by Tier 1 baseline.

default_job_timeout_minutes.description: Dial: Default pipeline job timeout in minutes (Allowed bound: 15..180).

enforce_settable_var_at_queue.description: Dial: Restrict variables that can be set when a pipeline is queued only to those explicitly marked settable at queue time.

enforce_job_auth_scope_to_project.description: Dial: Limit job authorization scope to the current project for non-release and release pipelines.

enforce_referenced_repo_scoped_token.description: Dial: Protect access to repositories in YAML pipelines by scoping tokens to explicitly referenced repositories.

publish_pipeline_metadata.description: Dial: Allow pipelines to record build and deployment metadata for traceability.

repository_defaults.description: Organization-wide default branch protection dials applied to every project unless overridden within allowed bounds.

default_branch.description: Standard default branch name across the organization.

min_reviewers.description: Dial: Default minimum required reviewers on pull requests to the default branch (Allowed bound: 2..5).

reset_votes_on_new_push.description: Dial: Reset all approval votes when new changes are pushed to a pull request source branch.

require_work_item_linking.description: Dial: Require every pull request to link at least one Azure Boards work item.

require_comment_resolution.description: Dial: Require all PR review comments to be resolved before merge.

build_validation_expiry_hours.description: Dial: Hours before a passing PR build validation expires if the target branch is updated (Allowed bound: 12..72).

agent_pools.description: Self-hosted or Managed DevOps Pool definitions at the organization level.

auto_provision.description: Dial: Automatically provision queues in all projects (Default: false to maintain least privilege).
